description: DBnomics economic time-series aggregator — enumerate the datasets published by one DBnomics provider code (ECB, BLS, EUROSTAT, IMF, OECD, WB and 80+ national statistics agencies). Returns each dataset's code, name and dimension metadata, paged with limit/offset; those codes are what get_series and find_series expect. Answers which statistical datasets the ECB, IMF or Eurostat publish on DBnomics.
name: list_datasets
